# Juan Pablo Bascur

> Personal website of Juan Pablo Bascur Cifuentes, Senior Data Analyst at Elsevier. The site covers his professional experience, research publications, data-science projects, CV, and creative writing.

## Professional

- [Professional profile](https://jpbascur.com/professional/): Current profile and access to the official CV.
- [Detailed work history](https://jpbascur.com/work-history/): Education, employment, teaching, academic service, and expertise.
- [Publications and projects](https://jpbascur.com/publications/): Research papers, open-source software, and live data-science tools.
- [Curriculum vitae](https://jpbascur.com/files/cv.pdf): Current CV in PDF format.

## Personal

- [Personal space](https://jpbascur.com/personal/): Entry point for personal projects, interests, and writing.
- [Creative writing](https://jpbascur.com/writing/): Index of stories by Juan Pablo Bascur.
